title: TicketCreate
key_points: The TicketCreate transaction creates a ticket for a given amount to be redeemed later.
Tickets can only be created by the owner of a trust line or account.
When creating a ticket, the issuer specifies the ticket's amount and the address where it will be redeemed.
A TicketCreate transaction includes the issuer's account ID, the ticket's unit amount in drops, the recipient's account ID, and an optional expiration time.
limitations: The documentation does not specify real-world use cases or examples for using the TicketCreate transaction type.
asserts: Tickets can be created by the owner of a trust line or account to be redeemed later.
scope: Describes how tickets are issued and redeemed in the XRP Ledger protocol.
